name: Fotor
tagline: Fotor is an online photo editing and graphic design platform that combines traditional editing tools with AI-powered features like background removal, face retouch, photo enhancement, and AI art generation. Its template library covers social media graphics, posters, and marketing materials. Over 600 million users have used Fotor as an accessible, browser-based alternative to Photoshop.
